# LibreHardwareMonitor dependency

This local hardware edition uses `LibreHardwareMonitorLib` 0.9.6 from the
official NuGet package to read CPU, GPU, and memory sensors. The library is
licensed under MPL-2.0. Package metadata and licenses are restored by NuGet.

The application enables only CPU, GPU, and memory monitoring. Storage,
motherboard, controller, and network probes remain disabled.
